summary: First-finish smoke test for SDU Cold Email Outreach app. Auth, CSV upload, stats, list/PATCH/DELETE, graceful failure of Gemini (empty key) and Resend (empty key), settings, password change+revert, logs, CSV export, logout all verified. Frontend login -> dashboard -> upload -> edit dialog -> /logs -> /settings -> logout E2E flow all working.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin123 -> 200 and sdu_session cookie set
Upload bad header -> skipped with 'Missing required columns: company_name, contact_email'
Upload bad email format -> skipped with 'Invalid contact_email: not-an-email'
POST /api/emails/generate with empty GEMINI_API_KEY -> result.status=failed, error='Gemini: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set' (graceful, server alive)
POST /api/emails/send ungenerated -> result.status=failed, error='Email not generated'
POST /api/emails/send generated but no RESEND_API_KEY -> result.status=failed, error='RESEND_API_KEY is not set'
PUT /api/settings/password: admin123 -> newpass1, login with newpass1 succeeds, reverted to admin123
GET /api/logs/export returns CSV with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=send_logs.csv
Frontend: login page renders, admin123 redirects to dashboard
Frontend: upload-input accepts sample_companies.csv and table populates with btn-edit-{id} rows
Frontend: nav to /logs (logs-search-input visible) and /settings (settings-daily-limit visible)

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 functional; 1 test-script JSON parsing assertion failed but actual 502 status was correct)

notes: GEMINI_API_KEY and RESEND_API_KEY are empty as required; all integration paths fail gracefully without crashing the server. No mocked APIs.
